context: A handmade-goods stall opening for the day at an outdoor market
purpose: Sell handmade items; teach 売り/つくる/わずか/最低/トラブル/売る/売っ

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今日の売り場、ええ感じに並んだわ。
lines.en: The stall came together nicely today.
lines.style: satisfied Kansai craftsman surveying his morning setup

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: この小物、全部手でつくるんですか？
lines.en: You make all these little things by hand?
lines.style: genuinely curious helper admiring the goods

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そうや、一個ずつ自分でつくるから時間かかんねん。
lines.en: Yep, I make each one myself, so it takes time.
lines.style: proud but matter-of-fact about the slow craft

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 値段は最低でもどれくらいですか？
lines.en: What is the lowest the prices go?
lines.style: practical assistant checking the pricing range

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 最低五百円やな。それ以下やと赤字や。
lines.en: Five hundred yen minimum. Below that I lose money.
lines.style: firm shopkeeper drawing a hard pricing line

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日は何かトラブルありました？
lines.style: checking in carefully about the previous day

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: いや、わずかな釣り銭ミスだけや。大したことない。
lines.en: No, just a tiny change mistake. Nothing big.
lines.style: breezily dismissing a small trouble as trivial

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあ今日もたくさん売りましょう。
lines.en: Then let us sell a lot again today.
lines.style: cheerful and motivated to start the day

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、売れ筋から売っていこか。
lines.en: Sure, let us start with the best sellers.
lines.style: energetic Kansai owner ready to move stock

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: この棚のは全部、夕方までに売るで。
lines.en: Everything on this shelf, I will sell by evening.
lines.style: confident goal-setting for the day ahead
